title: Muslims defeat the Quraysh at the Battle of Badr
summary: A small force led by Muhammad defeated a larger army of the Quraysh of Mecca near the wells of Badr. Several leading Meccans were killed.
reason: The Muslims of Medina had moved to intercept a Meccan caravan, and Mecca sent an army to protect it.
significance: The victory strengthened Muhammad's position in Arabia and is remembered in Islam as a sign of divine support.
